name: studded leather
enchant_note: Leather and a few iron rivets: a little magic, no more.
protection_note: Leather set with rivets, a little more for an edge to catch on.
protection_price: Catches fire, and fire scorches it.
lore_descriptor: set with iron rivets in offset rows
first_pickup_chronicle: Studded leather. The rivets catch the edges a clean cut would slip past. Real armor, by any honest measure, and it jingles less than mail.
